periods.time: vol-11 ch-002 middle phase of the final

name.zh: 史黛菈无预备发动龙神附身并制造岩浆战场
name.en: Stella uses Dragon Spirit without a tell and turns the ring to lava

periods.summary: Stella reveals that the self-stabbing motion she showed against Ouma was a cross-match deception: Dragon Spirit only requires raising her blood temperature. After Ikki refuses the bait, she activates it openly, surpasses his estimates, and with Wyrm Nest melts the ring into a lava sea. Ikki's spirit is shaken by the earnestness and scale of her power; Stella exploits this with Dragon Stomp, Mirage and a sword-feint into a dragon-powered body blow, knocking him unconscious. His trained body nevertheless uses Madoka while unconscious and cuts Stella badly, forcing her to retreat.
periods.cause: Stella's planned counter trap fails against Ikki's instincts, so she chooses the harder path of overpowering him directly.
periods.outcome: Both fighters learn that pure plans are insufficient: Stella discovers Ikki's body can resist beyond consciousness, and Ikki recognizes his own fear of her has become the true obstacle.
periods.significance: Turns the duel from tactical fencing into a confrontation with talent, fear, and the will stored in the body.
